question: Which of the following causes could lead to NON-LINEAR kinetic behavior at the level of distribution of a drug ?:

options.opa: Important variations in the enterohepatic cycle.
options.opb: Enzymatic autoinduction phenomenon developed over time.
options.opc: Saturation of the drug binding sites at the tissue level.
options.opd: Modification of the dissolved fraction of drug as the dose increases.

analysis: Saturation of the drug binding sites at the tissue level can lead to non-linear kinetic behavior at the level of distribution of a drug. When the binding sites become saturated, the rate of distribution may not increase proportionally with the dose, resulting in non-linear kinetics.
